desc: Establish the BFS-layer decomposition and EGF transition plan.
Implement the BFS-layer EGF dynamic program using sparse `(1+x)^E` shifts, reachable-state buckets, and packed big-int polynomial arithmetic.

Validate the implementation end-to-end: sample 1 reproduced by full statement-level trace; samples 2–3 entries (first, near-complete, trailing zeros) reproduced by independent combinatorial computation; brute-force checker agrees for N=2 and N=4.

Test edge cases: N=2 traced to output `1`; tree counts match Prüfer formula for N=4,6,10; complete-graph trailing zeros confirmed for even N≥4; overflow/carry safety of packed arithmetic proven (≤15 contributions < 2^64 per 128-bit limb); pure-Python fallback mirrors the verified numpy path with identical semantics.
Fix any discrepancies found by validation — none found; no performance issue (≈10⁵ bignum ops, well under time limits).
